# Problem Set 1

```{r}
#add ggplot
library(ggplot2)

#fake data
temp_ice_cream <- data.frame(
  temperature = c(30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100), #temperature in Fahrenheit
  ice_cream_sales = c(2, 6, 8, 50, 65, 78, 90, 110) #number of ice cream cones sold at ice cream truck
)

#basic scatter plot from fake data
ggplot(temp_ice_cream, aes(x = temperature, y = ice_cream_sales)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation between temperature and ice cream sales",
    x = "Temperature (degrees Fahrenheit)",
    y = "Ice Cream Sales (number of ice cream cones sold)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
